name: @reportproof/security-intake
description: Open-source security report intake checks for maintainers.

scripts.check:syntax: npm run build && node --check dist/cli.js && node --check dist/action.js && node --check dist/config.js && node --check dist/evaluate.js && node --check dist/rules.js
scripts.benchmark:results: npm run build && node dist/evaluate.js --output docs/benchmark-results.md
scripts.check:benchmark-results: npm run build && node dist/evaluate.js --check-output docs/benchmark-results.md
scripts.oss-trial:results: npm run build && node dist/evaluate.js --report oss-trial --output docs/oss-trial-results.md
scripts.check:oss-trial-results: npm run build && node dist/evaluate.js --report oss-trial --check-output docs/oss-trial-results.md
